entries.brief: Create ONE square original painterly fantasy bestiary portrait for SKAZ. Broad sculpted brush shapes, readable at 40 pixels, moderate detail, warm upper-left light and cool shadows. Isolated head-and-shoulders bust, complete head with 10 percent transparent margins, TRUE TRANSPARENT background. An enormous aristocratic cloud giant with pale blue-white living skin, silver-white curled hair, broad long nose and thoughtful proud expression. Rich ivory and muted blue robes with restrained bronze clasp, a solid metal morningstar beside one shoulder. Clearly humanoid, NOT made of clouds. Compact dignified silhouette. No crown, no scenery, no cloud background, no text, no frame, no UI.

Create ONE square original painterly fantasy bestiary portrait for SKAZ. Broad sculpted brush shapes, readable at 40 pixels, moderate detail, warm upper-left light and cool shadows. Isolated head-and-shoulders bust, complete head and shoulder outline inside 10 percent transparent margins, TRUE TRANSPARENT background. A massive IRON GOLEM, an artificial solid cast-iron humanoid warrior. Thick dark iron plates with restrained rust at seams, broad square forged head, sculpted severe metal face with recessed dark eyes and narrow mouth vent. Heavy blunt shoulders, one broad solid metal sword blade alongside shoulder. No living skin, no beard, no human wearing armor, no machinery wires, no gears, no fire or electric glow. Ancient magical construct, not science fiction robot. No text, scenery, frame or UI.

Create ONE square original painterly fantasy bestiary portrait for SKAZ. Broad sculpted brush shapes, readable at 40 pixels, moderate detail, warm upper-left light and cool shadows. Isolated upper-body bust with 10 percent transparent margins, TRUE TRANSPARENT background. An ETTIN: one huge brutish giant body with exactly TWO DISTINCT heads side by side on two short necks. Both heads are fully visible with space between silhouettes: left head broad bald scalp and broken yellow teeth, right head tangled dark hair and scowling heavy brow. Muddy tan living skin, primitive fur garment. A battleaxe blade at far left shoulder and a morningstar head at far right shoulder hint its two weapons. No extra face, no overlapping heads, no horns. Compact broad silhouette, two heads are the dominant readable feature. No text, scenery, frame or UI.
